recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.headnote: The Millenial Dilemma. Admit it. It’s incredible.

items: The whole point of this breakfast is you don’t have to prepare
Like, it’s literally the meal that prepares you for the day ahead.
Toast your bread
Poach your eggs
Butter toast
Mush on that avocado (if you slice it, I’ll gut ya)
On goes the egg
On goes the nuch’
On goes the Mama Lil’s
On with the EBTB
Face that mf

notes: I’m hunting down the bread for you guys, but I found a banger. I’ll try to find a way to incorporate hollandaise on extra slow mornings.

recipes.title: Aioli

items: Remove crust and soak bread in milk for 5 min
Smash garlic into pestle and mortar
Strain milk in cloth
Plop bread in mortar and smash until it’s a fine paste. Took me ~5 min
Drop in egg and salt then mash until thick and sticky
Add in EVOO drop by drop at first, then a splash at a time when constitution resembles a heavy mayo
Whisk in lemon juice to taste (patience!)

notes: Gear: pestle and mortar, cheese cloth, whisk.

recipes.title: Buttermilk

items: Stir in 1 cup of whole milk with 1 tbsp white distilled vinegar
Let rest for 10 minutes

notes: Don’t fuck it up.

items: Mix the parsley, oregano, paprika, shallot and EVOO in a bowl
Add the salt, pepper and red wine vinegar before service

recipes.title: Easy Pizza Sauce

items: Mince the garlic
Mix it all in a quart-sized mason jar and shake it up.

notes: Wear sunscreen. Contribute to an IRA when you’re young. Take the stairs. Call your mom.

items: Combine
Shake hard as f for 30+ seconds

recipes.title: Hollandaise

items: Bain-marie on stove
Mix in yolks, vinegar, salt, lemon juice
Whisk over bain-marie, steaming, couple min
Gradually spoon in bain-marie water
Whisk until light in color and holds a figure 8 drizzle
Mix in as much clarified butter as possible without splitting. We want mayo consistency

notes: Halve all.
Serve atop a poached egg over sourdough with crispy shallots in shallot oil. Spread roast garlic. Top with chili crisp and green onion.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic

items: Preheat oven to 350
Remove stem from garlic, leaving root
Place root-down in sheet of foil, wrap
Top with salt and pepper, carefully drizzle in shallot oil
Bake 30 min at 350

notes: Dish break.

items: Finely slice a shallot
In a saucepan, heat 1/2 cup olive oil (EVOO) to medium
Mix in shallot and stir until golden brown
Sieve immediately, save shallot oil and crispy shallots separately
Roast
Separate meat
Fill 2 inches above
Skim
Add veggies
Simmer
Strain and refrigerate
Skim
Reduce

recipes.title: Thai Custard
recipes.headnote: (serve over sticky rice). More secrets from the esteemed nana of cuisine.

items: Boil water in the bottom of a steamer
Hand whisk ingredients in a bowl
Strain into another bowl and put the bowl in a steamer
Steam for 20-30 minutes. Test with a fork. Steam until the center is no longer custard
Medium high heat, cook bacon in EVOO (do it) until fat is rendered, before crisp
Lift bacon and set to drain on towel
On high, add sprouts open side down
Sear HARD 5-7 min
Flip and season
Add in dates and bacon, toss very well
Add stock in waves, squishing dates with spoon
Once broken down, add vinegar and cook until it coats sprouts, before it gets sticky

recipes.title: French Onion Soup

items.name: stock
items.note: chicken ok, use beef or bouillon if possible

items: Cook your onions low, covered, until all onions are sweated, steamed, and playing
Uncover and turn heat to medium. Toss in salt and sugar
Cook 30-40 min until they’re all golden brown
While cooking, bring stock to a simmer
Sprinkle in flour to onions, then stir a few min
Kill heat to onions and pour in stock, wine, salt and pepper to taste
Simmer down to half, partially covered, skim topping foam to cup
Preheat oven to 350 and lay out bread slices
Bake until golden brown, 20-30 min
Place cooled croutes in cocottes and ladle reduced soup over. This will trap onion above the bread.
Cover generously with parm and broil ’til cheese is browned on top
Serve immediately and safely

notes: Gear: 5 quart dutch oven (I like cast iron), 2 gallon pot, a cup for the foam, cocottes.

recipes.title: Fuckin Spring Rolls
recipes.headnote: This is the one. I won’t sugar coat it; this is a bitch to make, so make a lot. Recruit friends, make a day of it. This will get you remembered.

items.name: egg roll wraps
items.note: spring roll wraps might work; lumpia wraps break too easily

items: Cook ground turkey
Soak bean starch noodles
Prep all veggies
Microwave noodles and chop to 1"
Mix all ingredients (not eggs, wraps) in a bowl
Heat 1" of oil in a large pan/wok

Put a dollop of mixture in a wrap and roll up tight, sealing with egg (too tight and they will burst; too little egg and the roll can come undone in the pan; don’t make more than 10 ahead of cooking, they'll dry out and break)
slide in oil from the side of the pan
use tongs to flip when the bottom is brown
put cooked rolls on paper towels to drain and soak

notes: Eat as you go; you deserve the extras.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread

items: Remove stem from garlic, exposing each clove, wrap in foil, top open
Drizzle EVOO, generously salt and pepper, twist foil tight
Bake at 350 for 30 min
Finely slice shallot
In a saucepan, heat 1/2 cup EVOO to medium
Mix in shallot and stir until golden brown
Sieve immediately and save oil and shallots separately
Melt 1/4 cup salted butter
In blender cup, mix half the shallot oil, roasted garlic cloves, melted butter, 2 pinches salt
Pulse until coarse
Cut baguette along length
Spread remaining butter
Spread or pour garlic spread
Broil until brown and top with shallot crisps

notes: The list says 1/4 cup EVOO, written over 1/2. The shallot step still says 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese
recipes.headnote: I’ll try not to overcomplicate this, but this was Frankenstein's monster of a leftover night that ended up being one of the best meals I’ve ever assembled. A wicked sleeper that, if plated with some rosemary & diligence, would blow any date night out of the water.
recipes.yield: DON'T SHARE THIS THEY CAN MAKE THEIR OWN (your words from the future, not mine)

items: Grate 1T parmesan
Slice focaccia
Debone your ribs
Heat your pan to medium-high and toss a healthy dollop of butter onto the pan. Brown it. Melt, froth, foam, and stir like crazy so it doesn't stick or ash.
Rub one side of sliced focaccia with salt and parmesan and lay face down
Top with cheese and ribs
Same treatment to the other slice and set it on top.
Flip and dance, and don’t spill it everywhere.

notes: I used a beloved panini press, so the pan directions are a little bit of a guess. However, I bet a cast iron treatment would smack.

recipes.title: Hot Philly Cheesesteaks
recipes.headnote: The New Staple. I’ve been asking everyone to pick me up a hot Philly for 6 years, and I recently discovered just how easy it is to make one.

items: Heat a cast iron pan on medium
Thinly slice half of your yellow onion. Shoot for 1/8th” or thinner
Drop your butter underneath your onions on one half of the pan; in the other half, scoop in the Mama Lil’s. They can touch but can't canoodle
When your onions are golden and your peppers are charred, evenly distribute them into your hoagies.
Make two hoagie-shaped parallel piles of meat in your pan.
Top the meat with the Swiss
Pour in the water and cover the pan for about 30 seconds while the cheese turns into a gooey mess.
Scoop into your sandwiches
Grub

notes: Your South Philly impression isn’t as good as you think.

recipes.title: Larp Chicken & Sticky Rice
recipes.headnote: This is my mom’s favorite Thai dish. It’s just really fuckin good. You do need a thai rice basket for this.

items: 24 Hours Prior: Rinse sticky rice and soak overnight in room temperature water
Day Of: Chop all the veggie
Boil water in a rice pot
Drain water from soaking rice
Put rice in a Thai rice basket for 2 minutes, then flip
After 10 more minutes, flip
After 10 more minutes, flip
After 10 more minutes, put in a serving bowl or Thai rice basket
Fry in light oil-cook, don’t brown
Add ground rice
Add fish sauce
Add lime juice to taste
Add pepper flakes
Mix salad with ground chicken
Serve alongside rice

recipes.title: Latkes

items: Shred and rinse potatoes, strain through a cheese cloth and pass into medium mixing bowl
Over bowl, grate 1 shallot
Beat 3 eggs and pass through a sieve into bowl
Spoon together until homogenized, lumps ok
Mix in salt and flour until flour disappears
Over medium heat, fry until golden brown and set on rack to drip
Top with chili crisp, sour cream, scallions and shallot crisps

notes: You can use mash potatoes but your cakes will look like pancakes.
You can use apple sauce and scallions for a more traditional plate.

items: Heat oil in wok over medium heat
Add in garlic, onion whites and dried chili and cook (30 sec) till fragrant
Add pork and cook (2 min)
Add bean paste and stir in (1 min)
Add chicken stock
Add oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, ground Sichuan pepper, stir to cook (2 min)
Mix in corn starch slurry until thickened (2 min)
Carefully stir in tofu until heated through, finish with sesame oil and salt to taste
Plate and top with green onions

recipes.title: Mashed Potatoes

items: Crush garlic and quarter potatoes
Boil spuds and garlic in salt water (~30 min)
Mince sage
Warm cream
Add 4 tablespoons butter, 1 tablespoon chopped sage, and thyme
Raise heat to medium and whisk. Do not let boil.
Brown remaining butter with remaining sage and rosemary
Sieve butter into stand mixer
Mix in cream and potatoes
Slice onion root on bias
Serve potatoes warm topped with onion and sour cream

notes: Focus up here. If you boil your cream, you have to take your stove apart mid service!
If you overcook your butter, you get grey potatoes with charcoal aftertaste!

recipes.title: Pad Thai, Baby

items.name: Enough viper venom to bring down a mature male Ibex
sriracha
items.note: Stop reading the ingredients, but actually get some sriracha; idk how much. Depends. How tough are you?

items: Soakin’ noods put the noodles in a larger bowl and let it soak for 30-45 minutes while you prep.
Mix your shit K put all your fish sauce, veggie oil, sriracha, & peanut butter in a teeny lil bowl
Solids this time. Insert some minced garlic, diced onions, sug’, pap’, peanuts, goin in a bow.
Scramble your eggs in a big ol pan (think wok sized) or a huge pot.
Add your solids and liquids.

Why did I have you place them separately? I’m an asshole. Jokes on you, idiot. Washing an extra bowl tonight cause Cody said so. Tosh saved you a dish; I wasted one. Entropy is everywhere. That’s what you get for using a cookbook both pad thai and chocolate cake, you maniac.
Take a breath. Calm down. I’m sorry. I didn’t mean it.
Come back. It won’t be like before. I promise. Sorry I told you to calm down I should have never misled you in the first place.

K, that was fuckin weird. Check your noodles. Eat one. If it’s al dente, throw it in the microwave for 30 seconds. Cody, why didn’t you just have me do that in the first place? Because I wanted you to learn a lesson and prepare. Mise en place.

Drain noodles, add to the rest of the ingredients, and cook ‘em. Stir it around. Don’t let it burn. It takes a bit to cook, but you’ll know when the noods get sticky. I’m pretty bad at this and I have never messed up this step.

notes: I shit you not, I just made a wrap with some leftover pad thai, a flour tortilla, more peanut butter, more sriracha, and an egg. Heat up the leftovers in a frying pan, put the peanut butter and ‘rach’ in the tortilla, fry an egg over medium, then toss in that little number. Chow time. bonus points if you panini press or bake the lil nugget.

items: In a large pan/wok, bring 1 can coconut milk to simmer and scoop in curry paste
Dice and trim chicken
Add bird and simmer until 75% cooked
Add the rest, sans basil, and simmer until bamboo softens
Serve over rice and top with basil
Soak chilis
Mush it in a pestle and mortar

Mince 1/2 cucumber into mise cup
Add second half of the rice vinegar, soy, fish sauce
Seal, label, refrigerate for 2 days
Rinse 2 cups rice until clear, rest 20 min
In saucepan, mix mirin, half the rice vinegar, sugar, salt and simmer low until dissolved. Do not burn sugar.
Cook rice, then fold with sauce, rest to cool
Cover baking sheet with saran wrap and spoon rice over evenly
Cover with second wrap and flatten with equal size baking sheet

Mince jalapeños and set aside
Open onion greens into flat sheets and fold into short, 1-inch stacks
Finely slice into onion “hairs” and set aside
Mix 2 tablespoons wasabi and 4 tablespoons soy in ramekins
Mix Kewpie, sriracha, sesame oil and transfer into mise bottle or piping bag
Divide rice into 1/2-inch by 2-inch small blocks
Heat 1/2 inch fry oil in deep carbon steel pan
Using long tweezers, place rice blocks in 30 sec intervals to avoid boiling pan
Turn and remove when golden brown all over
Mince the ahi and place in a medium mixing bowl with 1/4 cup sriracha dressing and mix
Plate the ever living piss out of this one.

recipes.title: Boozy Iced Coffee
recipes.headnote: It’s caffeinated. It’s creamy. It will put you flat on your ass. Inspired by the old-school iced Kahlua Kicker @ Dutch Bros.

items: Grind coffee beans mildly more coarse than you would for a traditional pot.
Put 300g ice in chemex; store in freezer
Boil ~1 liter water, let rest to 208ºF. If you don’t have a thermometer, give it about 2 minutes resting at room temp.
Bloom that batch. Pull out your chemex, toss in a fresh filter, dump your 30g of grind in and shake level. Set on scale & reset to 0 with grind & filter sitting over ice.

Slowly pour enough water to soak all the grind and stop. Rule of thumb is 2x the amount of grind (30g X 2 = 60ml), but if I can manage to soak all my grind with less water, I’ll stop. Don't reset your scale.

After blooming has stopped and the grind has sunk back, slowly pour in 300ml water and stop. I swirl the grind as it brews for an even extraction, but I have no evidence this actually works any better than just waiting. Should take around 4 minutes to brew. Tighten or loosen your grind to fit your taste.
Toss your filter & grind
Add your booze and swirl it around like the hipster you are. Serve over ice in a beaker or something pretentious.

notes: (requires Chemex or V60 w/ carafe w/ a food scale)
Workin on a salted caramel Kicker recipe - stay tuned.

items: Over ice, pour 1 oz Campari and 1 oz sweet vermouth and stir to chill
Top glass with Peroni or Italian beer, saving 1 inch at top
Pour a couple splashes of beer in a separate container, add a pinch of salt to bubble, and whisk or stir with a mixer until it foams
Top bev with foam and serve
Warm 660+ ml water to 205°F and hold
Measure 42 g medium roast
Spritz with spray bottle to kill static
Grind to coarse consistency similar to rice width
On scale, tare and check 42 g, tare to 0
While waiting on water, light a tealight warmer
When hot, pour 84 g over grind, saturating most or all grounds, let bloom for 60 sec
When bloomed, pour remaining 560 ml (to 660 on scale) at the same pace water pours out to maintain temp
When poured, hold Chemex and take a cleanup lap around kitchen for even extraction

recipes.title: Piña Colada
recipes.headnote: I want a Piña Colada almost every day of this goddamn existence.

items: Throw it all in a blender.

notes: Get a mason jar out of your cupboard, go to Goodwill, and find a blender with a pitcher that has the same threading as your mason jar. It’s probably going to be an old Oster line. Buy it. Toss the pitcher and whatever Ninja bullshit you bought in college. Now you have a blender that you can fix yourself with some light googling, get parts at any Goodwill, and instead of dealing with that fat pitcher fuckery, you can just screw on literal mason jars and toss them in the dishwasher when you’re done. Added bonus is a 32oz mason jar already has the 100ml markings on it.
